Summary: Ensures the emergency hotfix window has the minimum decision, communication, and rollback discipline.
EntryCriteria: A hotfix path has been chosen and the team is preparing to execute under incident conditions.
ExitCriteria: Rollback owner, communications path, watch coverage, and blast-radius framing are explicit.
Checks: Incident commander and hotfix specialists are assigned.
Rollback trigger sheet is available and understood.
Customer or stakeholder communication path is prepared.
First-hour telemetry watch owner is assigned.
